notes.title: Winter Polaris available in Chinese!《冬季北极星》中文版现已推出！
notes.notes:
Thanks to the help of some wonderful translators and programmers, we're finally able to bring you the Chinese version of Winter Polaris, available both in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

In celebration, Winter Polaris will be on 30% off for the week! 
Please tell your friends and enjoy!

多亏了优秀的翻译和程序人员的帮助 ， 我们终于可以为大家带来正式的中文版《冬季北极星》 。
简体和繁体两种版都有 。
为了庆祝 ， 《冬季北极星》本周将有 30% 的折扣 。

notes.title: Winter Polaris C97 Drama CD available for free download!
notes.notes:
Fans of Winter Polaris will be delighted to have access to the drama CD released in Winter Comiket 97, available to everyone for free.

Find out more about the mysterious universe that Winter Polaris takes place in with this audio drama CD. Learn about Tsubaki's origin and discover the source of immortality. Fans of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/348950/Ame_no_Marginal_Rain_Marginal/]Ame no Marginal[/url] will find a particular rainy world quite familiar.

Audio is in full Japanese. A fully translated English text script is included in the soundtrack's files. Please open up the file to follow along.

Thanks to everyone for their continued support of stage-nana!

notes.title: Trading cards are here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Trading cards are finally here!

Sorry for the long delay. As you know, stage-nana games tend to be very sparse in visuals, so we had some struggles getting the many backgrounds, cards, iconts, and badges to a good place. But we've finally managed to do it! Enjoy!

notes.title: Typo fixes and Trading cards coming soon
notes.notes:
Quick little update. A number of typos that had been reported were fixed, 

We've also submitted trading cards for review and if everything goes well with that process, they'll be releasing in the near future.

Thanks for everyone's support, hope you enjoy the game!
